title: Senior director
description: Requisition ID: 50092 Business Unit: Fitch Ratings Category: Credit Analysis & Research Location: São Paulo, BR; Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR Senior Director, Latin American Corporates, Infrastructure & Project Finance (CIPF) – Energy, Power & Utilities We will Count on You To: Lead coverage of a portfolio across the Energy, Power & Utilities sectors in Latin America, with a particular focus on Brazil. Have direct managerial responsibility for analysts within the team, providing leadership, coaching, and development support while fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture. Oversee the analysis of key quantitative and qualitative factors influencing credit quality across corporates and project finance entities in the sector. Supervise the maintenance, and review of detailed financial models and credit analyses used to support rating recommendations. Chair and participate actively in internal rating committees, presenting clear and well-supported rating recommendations for both international and national scale ratings, where applicable. Serve as a senior point of contact for external market participants, including issuers, investors, bankers, advisors, and other stakeholders in the rating process. Articulate Fitch’s credit views, rating rationales, and sector outlook in a clear, engaging, and commercially aware manner through meetings, conference calls, written commentary, and published research. Contribute to the strategic direction and visibility of Fitch’s Latin America CIPF franchise , including representing Fitch in conferences, industry forums, and client events. Support the management of the regional portfolio across multiple regulatory environments, ensuring high analytical standards, consistency, and timeliness in rating actions and research output. Partner closely with colleagues across sectors, countries, and analytical groups to advance the One CIPF approach and strengthen Fitch’s market presence across Latin America. Write and oversee timely, insightful research on sector trends, market developments, and topical credit issues affecting the Energy, Power & Utilities space. Mentor and develop junior team members, helping to build analytical depth and succession within the franchise. What You Need to Have: 10+ years of relevant experience in credit analysis, project finance, capital markets, corporate or investment banking, or a related field. Strong knowledge of the Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, ideally including exposure to regulated utilities, power generation, transmission, renewables, and/or midstream or energy infrastructure assets. Demonstrated experience managing people and/or leading teams in an analytical environment. Solid understanding of financial statement analysis, credit fundamentals, and debt capital structures. Proven ability to assess and explain analytically complex topics with sound judgment and intellectual rigor. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluency in English and Portuguese required; Spanish strongly preferred. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, master’s degree, CFA, CPA, or other advanced professional qualification preferred. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility with internal and external stakeholders. What Would Make You Stand Out: Deep knowledge of, and strong interest in, the Brazilian Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, with a desire to continue expanding expertise across related corporate and project finance subsectors. A strong professional background in capital markets and/or credit analysis, supported by well-developed financial statement analysis and credit assessment skills. Demonstrated interest in deepening exposure to and understanding of the debt capital markets, particularly as they relate to Latin American issuers and infrastructure assets. A clear pattern of leadership, with the ability to proactively and effectively engage with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally. Presence, judgment, and communication skills to represent Fitch credibly with issuer management teams, investors, bankers, and market participants. A collaborative mindset and a strong commitment to mentoring junior analysts and contributing to the development of the broader team.

title: Hsseq superintendent
description: Location Country: Brazil Work Location: Rio de Janeiro Who are V? As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals - people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders. Overall Purpose of The Job Act as a HSSEQ resource to the Fleet. To ensure the safe operation of assigned fleet/vessels, and to provide an effective link between the Fleet Cell and those on board. To verify and monitor all HSEQ activities in the operation of the Fleet and to ensure that adequate resources and shore-based support is applied as required. Key Responsibilities And Tasks Risk Management Collaborate with the assigned Fleet Superintendent to control and monitor the risk for assigned vessels and to act as a member of the risk assessment team for shipboard procedures and operations when called upon to do so. Investigate any accidents, incidents, near misses and unsafe observations on-board fleet vessels and make recommendations to prevent a recurrence. Ensure pro-active follow-up on corrective actions with vessels as required. Share any safe / best practices on-board fleet vessels are recognized and shared. Act as a member of the Emergency Response Team during an emergency. Compliance Act as Company Security Officer (CSO) and plan internal ISPS audits for designated fleet/vessels within the required timescales. Collaborating with the shipboard team and the Fleet Superintendent, prepare vessels for inspection/audit by PSC, Flag, Oil Major and similar bodies as a shared responsibility. Arrange third party inspections such as Oil Major, CDI and flag state inspections and co-ordinate response. Plan and control internal audits for assigned vessels, utilizing Group resources as appropriate Plan and control external audits for assigned vessels by the auditing authority Maintain navigational standards by regular review of navigational practices, procedures, and any improvements required for assigned vessels. Ensure all vessels have an annual sailing navigation audit, or equivalent Remote VDR audit. Monitor shipboard drug and alcohol testing. Act as Deputy DPA when required, and to assist and support the DPA to monitor as a minimum the following for his or her assigned vessels: Communication and implementation of the safety and environmental protection policy; Evaluation and review of the effectiveness of the safety management system; Reporting and analysis of non-conformities, accidents and hazardous occurrences; Maintain ISM certification and organising and monitoring of internal audits; Appropriate revisions to the SMS; and Ensuring that adequate resources and shore based support is provided. Operational Management Prepare ‘visitation plans’ to gain thorough familiarization of assigned vessels, safety equipment, challenges and safety culture onboard. Following inspection, issue safety inspection reports to the company standard along with remedial actions required. Co-ordinate the provision of specialist advice on all marine and operational matters, actively promoting and supporting the development of effective professional working partnerships between Senior Officers onboard vessels and the ship management team ashore. Handle/liaise with the Master on P&I and Insurance claims, when required Evaluate vessel requirements with regard to mooring ropes, marine and safety equipment. Client Relationship & Performance Management Provide timely and accurate information to Clients on all marine and operational matters, ensuring HSEQ input to client reports. Participate in the weekly Customer Temperature Dashboard review meetings, collaborating with the shore team to formulate robust action plans to drive improvement in performance of office and customer KPIs. Collect HSEQ statistical data of the fleet to support the CTD and Management Review processes. People Management Authorise selection process of Senior Officers for assigned Vessels. Brief Senior Officers during office visits on VMS, fleet requirements, vessel work plan etc. Ensure they have an understanding of the V. Ships values and are clear about the standards of performance expected and support available from the team ashore. Build and maintain a professional and effective working relationship with senior ship staff to influence the development of a strong safety culture. Conduct Senior Officer Performance Appraisals in accordance with VMS procedures and as play an active role in their personal development. What can I expect in return? V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth. Essential Minimum qualification of Class 2 (1st Mate) certificate of competency and seagoing experience as a Chief Officer pursuant to the International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watch- keeping for Seafarers (STCW), 1978, as amended, with not less than three years’ experience as a senior shipboard officer and five years of relevant ship type experience, or Other formal education combined with not less than three years’ practical senior level experience in ship management operations in a shipping company with relevant ship type experience, or Qualifications from a tertiary institution recognized by the Administration or by the recognised organisation, within a relevant field of management, engineering or physical science with not less than three years practical senior level experience in ship management operations in a shipping company with relevant ship type experience. Desirable Master’s Certificate of Competency (Class 1) with command experience. Good communication (oral and written) skills Good organisational and planning skills Good analytical and problem solving skills Good interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and interact with people at all levels.

title: Senior fpga developer
description: About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers. About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products. Responsibilities : The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere. Qualifications : BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs. Required Skills : Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment. Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description: About Us Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description: Short-Form Video Editor – Social Media & Content Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Schedule: 40 hours/week About the Client Our client is a marketing and creative agency that helps brands grow through a combination of digital marketing, social media, content creation, video production, paid media, and creative design . The agency works with brands across different industries, developing engaging, social-first content designed to build audiences, increase brand visibility, and support business growth. The team is currently expanding its video production capabilities to support a new college-focused social app . The project will involve creating authentic, engaging short-form content featuring college campuses, student conversations, street interviews, and promotional material. About the Role We are looking for a Short-Form Video Editor to join the creative team and support the launch of a new social app designed for college students. The primary focus of this role will be editing short-form social media content for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. You will work with raw footage, often recorded on phones or other lightweight equipment, and turn it into polished, engaging content that feels natural to a young U.S. audience. A strong understanding of social media culture, Gen Z content, pacing, storytelling, and current short-form video trends is important for this role. Candidates with previous experience editing street interviews, man-on-the-street content, campus videos, interviews, UGC, or youth-oriented social content are especially encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms. Turn raw phone-shot and camera footage into polished, engaging social content. Edit college campus tours, street interviews, student conversations, promotional videos, and UGC-style content. Review large amounts of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, reactions, quotes, and answers. Create strong hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds. Build a clear and engaging story from multiple clips. Use jump cuts, hard cuts, B-roll, and pacing to maintain viewer attention. Cut footage to music and beats when appropriate. Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, and other social-first elements. Perform basic color correction and audio cleanup. Maintain consistency in visual quality, pacing, and editing style across content. Repurpose footage into multiple short-form pieces when appropriate. Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently. Manage a high volume of content during the app's launch period. Potentially support video projects for other agency clients as the role develops. Requirements Proven experience editing short-form social media content . Strong proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable Adobe video-editing software. Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual rhythm. Ability to turn raw footage into engaging short-form content. Experience with basic color correction and audio editing. Ability to work effectively with phone-shot, raw, and imperfect footage. Good understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other short-form formats. Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines. Ability to work independently while taking direction and incorporating feedback. Strong English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience editing street interviews or man-on-the-street videos . Experience with college, campus, student, Gen Z, lifestyle, dating, social, or UGC content. Experience editing interviews and multi-person conversations. Experience working with high-volume social media content. Familiarity with Adobe After Effects . Basic motion graphics and animation skills. Experience creating engaging captions and animated text. Strong awareness of current TikTok and Instagram editing trends. The ideal candidate knows how to: Start with a strong hook. Remove unnecessary pauses, filler, and dead space. Keep conversations moving with natural cuts and jump cuts. Identify the funniest, most interesting, surprising, or relatable moments. Combine multiple interview responses into a cohesive story. Use B-roll strategically. Add clean, readable captions. Use music and sound effects when they enhance the content. Keep the content authentic and conversational. Avoid excessive transitions, effects, and animations when they don't add value.

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description: About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support. We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch. What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. title: Professor De Educação Física
description: Job overview We are looking for an experienced and qualified Physical Education teacher to join our Primary Section P.E Department at our Botafogo Site. We are seeking a dedicated educator to focus initially on teaching UK Key Stages 1 and 2, promoting sportsmanship, teamwork, and students’ overall well-being. Responsibilities Child Psychomotor Development: A deep understanding of body schemes, laterality, balance, and gross motor coordination for children aged 2 to 11 mainly. International Curricula and Methodologies: Familiarity with frameworks such as the EYFS (Early Years Foundation Stage) from the British curriculum Familiarity in international curricula like the IPC (International Primary Curriculum) , Cambridge Primary / International Baccalaureate (IB). Understanding the Transition from Early Years to Key Stage 1 / Primary A child-centered and play-based learning approach through movement and active games. Differentiation and Inclusion: Ability to design activity stations that accommodate different physical maturity levels. Introduction to Basic Game Rules & Sports Literacy: Ability to teach simplified versions of team sports (mainly volleyball, basketball, futsal and handball), cooperative games, gymnastics, track & field (athletics), and rhythm and movement. Spatial & Tactical Awareness: Teaching children how to share space, understand boundaries, play offense/defense in simple games, and follow rules safely. First Aid & CPR: Practically mandatory in international schools to manage safety during physical activities with young children. Child Protection & Safeguarding Training: A standard required certification across schools with British or American international curricula. Energy, Patience, and Empathy: Ability to lead high-energy classes while maintaining a safe, welcoming, and dynamic environment. Classroom Management in Open Spaces: Skill in keeping group attention and maintaining discipline through clear rules in gymnasiums or outdoors. Intercultural Sensitivity: Ability to work effectively with families and students from diverse nationalities and cultural backgrounds. Encouraging Sportsmanship & Teamwork: Guiding children through winning and losing gracefully, resolving minor conflict, and encouraging inclusive play. Formal Progress Tracking & Reporting: Experience with assessing movement competency, tracking individual progress against curriculum standards, and writing formal student reports for parents. Behavior Management: Ability to maintain structure and focus in larger spaces (gyms/fields) using clear routines, time-management techniques, and positive reinforcement for students. Key Requirements A degree and a teaching qualification in Physical Education (Licenciatura) Active registration - CREF. Fluency in English (C1 level) The candidate must reside in Brazil. Secure subject knowledge in Physical Education. Proven ability to teach UK Key Stages 1 and 2 effectively. Experience working in a school setting.

title: Product Owner (Po)
description: Sobre a Vaga Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para liderar a implementação da Reforma Tributária em nossos sistemas. O profissional será responsável por traduzir as exigências fiscais e as Normas Técnicas publicadas pelos órgãos reguladores em requisitos claros e acionáveis para os times de desenvolvimento, garantindo que nossas soluções estejam em conformidade com a nova legislação dentro dos prazos definidos pelo cronograma de transição. Responsabilidades Atuar como ponte entre a área fiscal/tributária e os times técnicos, traduzindo Normas Técnicas, notas técnicas e legislações (IBS, CBS, Split Payment, entre outras) em requisitos de produto e histórias de usuário. Priorizar e gerenciar o backlog de implementação da Reforma Tributária, equilibrando prazos regulatórios, complexidade técnica e impacto no negócio. Acompanhar as publicações de Notas Técnicas, layouts e atualizações de schemas (NF-e, NFC-e, CT-e, entre outros documentos fiscais) e avaliar seus impactos nos sistemas. Definir critérios de aceite e validar entregas junto aos times de desenvolvimento e QA. Interagir com stakeholders internos (fiscal, jurídico, contabilidade, TI) e, quando necessário, externos (consultorias tributárias, fornecedores de ERP/ferramentas fiscais). Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review) relacionadas à frente de reforma tributária. Monitorar o cronograma de transição da Reforma Tributária (fases de teste, coexistência e vigência plena) e garantir que as entregas estejam alinhadas aos marcos legais. Produzir documentação clara sobre as mudanças implementadas, para times internos e áreas de negócio. Requisitos Experiência prévia como Product Owner, Analista de Negócios ou função correlata, preferencialmente em produtos/sistemas fiscais ou tributários. Conhecimento fiscal sólido , com familiaridade em tributos sobre consumo (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, ISS) e, idealmente, nos fundamentos da Reforma Tributária (IBS, CBS, Imposto Seletivo). Capacidade comprovada de leitura e interpretação de Normas Técnicas, legislações e documentação regulatória, traduzindo-as em requisitos técnicos. Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares). Boa comunicação, com facilidade para dialogar tanto com áreas fiscais/jurídicas quanto com times técnicos. Perfil analítico, organizado e proativo na antecipação de riscos regulatórios. Diferenciais Experiência prévia em projetos de adequação a mudanças fiscais anteriores (ex.: implantação de NF-e, e-Social, EFD-Reinf). Conhecimento em sistemas ERP e módulos fiscais. Formação ou pós-graduação em Direito Tributário, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas. Certificação em Product Ownership (PSPO, CSPO ou similar). Modalidade: 100% remoto Modalidade de Contrato: PJ

title: Bookkeeper
description: Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support. Communicate with clients and team members through Slack , Zoom , and Google Workspace . Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines. Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency. Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations. What We’re Looking For Fluent in English Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time) Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools. Nice to Have Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana Prior experience working with startups or small businesses Why You’ll Love Working With Us At Aerial Core, we do things differently: Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload. Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it. Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success. Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained. The Aerial Core Way Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value. Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights. Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth. Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care. Ready to do accounting differently? Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (Unconventional Gas)- Relocate to Saudi Arabia
description: Senior Legal Counsel (Unconventional Gas) – Relocate to Saudi Arabia Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia. Aramco energizes the world economy. Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply. We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization. Overview We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization. The Gas Corp & Commercial Legal Practice provides legal support to the company’s upstream unconventional gas business, including drilling, production, processing and day-to-day operations as well as related joint ventures and subsidiaries. As Senior Counsel, your primary role is to provide comprehensive corporate and commercial legal services, working closely with internal stakeholders and coordinating with specialist legal teams in areas such as tax, intellectual property (IP), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and dispute resolution. The role will require collaboration with external legal counsel as needed. Key Responsibilities Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts and legal agreements. Provide strategic legal advice to internal clients, identifying and mitigating potential legal risks while supporting business objectives. Lead or support multidisciplinary legal and commercial projects, ensuring timely and effective delivery. Advise on claims management and dispute resolution processes. Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries. Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality. Required Qualifications A Bachelor of Law degree as minimum. Master or Juris degree preferred. Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident. A minimum of 10 years experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. Preferably within a major international or national energy company or oilfield services organization. Demonstrated in-depth understanding of the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly unconventional gas operations. Proven ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements and deliver clear, practical legal advice to business clients. Strong leadership and mentorship experience, with the ability to guide junior legal professionals. Prior experience serving as Corporate Secretary to a Board of Directors is highly desirable.
